cluster_decision.framing_hypothesis_comparison: Overrode the hypothesis: on a close reading the opportunity blends limpieza energetica with a non-canonical 'moving-house folklore' theme that fits no single canonical cluster and is not clearly a subcluster of one.
cluster_decision.justification: The theme sits between Limpeza Energetica and a possible new folklore/occasion cluster; formalizing that is an owner decision.
cluster_decision.deferral_reason: The opportunity may warrant a new canonical cluster; formal cluster governance is deferred (P6). Defer until the owner formalizes a cluster or Market Intelligence sharpens the theme.

cluster_fit.justification: no single canonical cluster covers the blended theme

asset_readiness.justification: an es cleansing playlist and a hero artist exist regardless of the final cluster

strategic_coherence.justification: adjacent to a core cluster but the theme is not yet crisp

red_flags.description: Taxonomy: the theme does not map cleanly to one of the 11 canonical clusters and may need P6 governance.

open_questions: Does the owner want to formalize a moving-house / folklore cluster, or fold this into Limpeza Energetica?

recommendation.recommended_next_step: Owner to decide whether to formalize a new canonical cluster in cluster-taxonomy.md, or to instruct that this opportunity is a Limpeza Energetica angle.
recommendation.justification: A cluster strategy cannot be finalized for an undecided cluster; P6 governance is deferred.
